import importlib.util, threading, time
from werkzeug.serving import make_server
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s2','stage-2/app.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
fixture={'currency':'EUR','minor_units':2,'users':[{'id':'u1','email':'a@example.com','display_name':'Alice','handle':'alice','password':'password123','balance':10000},{'id':'u2','email':'b@example.com','display_name':'Bob','handle':'bob','password':'password123','balance':5000}]}
assert m.app.test_client().post('/_test/reset',json=fixture).status_code == 204
srv = make_server('127.0.0.1', 8765, m.app)
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
time.sleep(0.2)
try:
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = browser.new_page(viewport={'width':390,'height':844})
        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8765/login')
        page.get_by_test_id('login-email').fill('a@example.com')
        page.get_by_test_id('login-password').fill('password123')
        page.get_by_test_id('login-submit').click()
        page.get_by_test_id('wallet-available').wait_for(timeout=5000)
        page.get_by_test_id('pay-handle').fill('bob')
        page.get_by_test_id('pay-amount').fill('12.50')
        page.get_by_test_id('pay-note').fill('Lunch')
        page.get_by_test_id('pay-submit').click()
        page.get_by_test_id('wallet-available').wait_for(timeout=5000)
        assert page.get_by_test_id('wallet-available').get_attribute('data-amount') == '8750'
        page.get_by_test_id('logout-button').click()
        page.get_by_test_id('login-email').wait_for(timeout=5000)
        browser.close()
finally:
    srv.shutdown()
print('stage-2 browser flow ok')

import importlib.util, threading, time
from werkzeug.serving import make_server
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s2','stage-2/app.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
fixture={'currency':'EUR','minor_units':2,'users':[{'id':'u1','email':'a@example.com','display_name':'Alice','handle':'alice','password':'password123','balance':10000},{'id':'u2','email':'b@example.com','display_name':'Bob','handle':'bob','password':'password123','balance':5000}]}

        page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8765/login', timeout=10000)
        page.get_by_test_id('login-email').fill('a@example.com')
        page.get_by_test_id('login-password').fill('password123')
        page.get_by_test_id('login-submit').click()

        page.get_by_test_id('pay-amount').fill('12.50')

        page.get_by_test_id('login-email').wait_for(timeout=5000)
        browser.close()
finally:
    srv.shutdown()
print('stage-2 browser flow ok')
